companies.name: バリック・マイニング

relations.text: ネバダの鉱山を統合した合弁会社NGMの経済的持分を、ニューモント38.5%、バリック61.5%で持つ
relations.text_en: In the Nevada JV, Newmont holds a 38.5 percent economic interest and Barrick holds a 61.5 percent economic interest in NGM

source.label: ニューモント 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Pursuant to the terms of the Nevada JV Agreement, we hold a 38.5 percent economic interest and Barrick holds a 61.5 percent economic interest in NGM.

relations.text: プエブロ・ビエホ鉱山はバリックが運営し、バリックが残り60%を持つ合弁事業である
relations.text_en: Pueblo Viejo is a joint venture with Barrick, which operates it and holds the remaining 60% interest

source.label: ニューモント 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Pueblo Viejo, Dominican Republic. (40% owned) Pueblo Viejo is a joint venture with Barrick, where Barrick is the operator who holds the remaining 60% interest.

relations.text: テックと共同運営する合弁事業があり、持分法で処理している
relations.text_en: A joint venture with Teck Resources Limited is jointly operated and accounted for as an equity method investment

source.label: ニューモント 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Joint venture with Teck Resources Limited that is jointly operated and accounted for as an equity method investment.

relations.text: あるプロジェクトを、残り50%を持つテックと共同で管理している
relations.text_en: One project is jointly managed with Teck Resources Limited, which holds the remaining 50% interest

source.label: ニューモント 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: The project is jointly managed by Newmont and Teck Resources Limited, who holds the remaining 50 % interest.

companies.name: ランディン・ゴールド

relations.text: エクアドルのフルタ・デル・ノルテ金鉱山を運営するランディン・ゴールドの株式32%を持つ
relations.text_en: Newmont holds a 32% equity interest in Lundin Gold, which operates the Fruta del Norte gold mine in Ecuador

source.label: ニューモント 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We also hold a 32% equity interest in Lundin Gold, a Canadian mine development and operating company, operating the Fruta del Norte gold mine in Ecuador, in addition to a variety of exploration and project joint ventures.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
